relationships.decisive_distinguishing_fact: Pending has no terminal outcome; failed has an explicit terminal processing failure.
relationships.risk_if_confused: An agent may recommend retrying a transfer that is still processing and cause a duplicate.

relationships.decisive_distinguishing_fact: Failed is a technical terminal outcome after submission; declined is an explicit refusal before normal processing.
relationships.risk_if_confused: The wrong retry or review path may be presented.

relationships.decisive_distinguishing_fact: Declined shows an explicit refusal; pending remains accepted for processing.
relationships.risk_if_confused: A refusal may be incorrectly described as a delay.

relationships.decisive_distinguishing_fact: The sender-side transfer is completed for not-received cases; it is non-terminal for pending cases.
relationships.risk_if_confused: The system may retrieve a sender pending workflow instead of recipient tracing.

relationships.decisive_distinguishing_fact: Pending remains open; reverted means a prior hold or posting was undone.
relationships.risk_if_confused: A still-open authorization may be falsely described as returned.

relationships.decisive_distinguishing_fact: Declined is an immediate refusal; pending is an accepted but unsettled authorization.
relationships.risk_if_confused: An agent may promise a pending release for a payment that was never accepted.

relationships.decisive_distinguishing_fact: Reverted has a prior hold or posting and a later reversal; decline has no accepted amount.
relationships.risk_if_confused: The customer may receive an invented return timeline for a decline.

relationships.decisive_distinguishing_fact: Pending has an open ledger entry; declined is a recognized refusal with no cash dispensed.
relationships.risk_if_confused: The wrong ledger or refusal workflow may be selected.

relationships.decisive_distinguishing_fact: Customer non-recognition overrides state troubleshooting and requires a security escalation.
relationships.risk_if_confused: A security event may be treated as an ordinary timing question.

relationships.decisive_distinguishing_fact: A declined case is a recognized attempt; a not-recognized case is disputed by the customer.
relationships.risk_if_confused: A recognized refusal may trigger an unnecessary security workflow, or a dispute may be under-escalated.

relationships.decisive_distinguishing_fact: One is a bank-transfer rail; the other is a merchant card authorization.
relationships.risk_if_confused: The retrieved controls may refer to the wrong payment rail.

relationships.decisive_distinguishing_fact: ATM cash interaction distinguishes withdrawal from merchant authorization.
relationships.risk_if_confused: An ATM ledger hold may receive merchant authorization guidance.
